checks.title: Confirm merchant goal and decision owners
checks.instructions: Name the store owner, growth owner, catalog owner, buyer task, specific product scope, and approved publish decision path.

checks.title: Bind exact store and market
checks.instructions: Record store ID, market, currency, language, URL, product and variant IDs, and the observation timezone. Do not join similar-looking products or markets by title alone.

checks.title: Define evidence and success rule
checks.instructions: Choose qualitative-only or a measured metric with segment, numerator, denominator, source, baseline window, comparison window, and minimum useful volume. Do not promise uplift from a public-page observation.

checks.title: Bind ready Shopify Crews
checks.instructions: Record existing or reviewed new Shopify Growth Analyst and Catalog & Merchandising Analyst Crew IDs, selected skills, and setup states. One Crew may serve both slots with compatible access and separate validated outputs.

checks.title: Test actual source access
checks.instructions: Inspect one public product/variant page, one matching authorized ProductVariant and inventory record, and an analytics report if a performance claim is planned. Record exact IDs, market, freshness, and access gaps.

checks.title: Validate opportunity and correction
checks.instructions: Validate shopify-growth-opportunity/v1 before Catalog reads it, then catalog-change-review/v1 for the same store, market, product, variant, and opportunity. Reject wrong-variant, unsupported-published, and unsupported-lift fixtures.

checks.title: Review the Automation plan
checks.instructions: Show actual Crew IDs, source field scope, artifact paths, validator, exact edit approval, publish permission, run cost, and manual route to the merchant owner.

checks.title: Run one real opportunity manually
checks.instructions: Use a real authorized product and observation. Record run IDs, artifacts, validator results, merchant decision, and observed result or unknown. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Track approved changes and measurement
checks.instructions: Keep stable opportunity/product/variant/action IDs, before value, approved after value, publisher, provider receipt, storefront retest, baseline and follow-up metric rules, and unresolved effects.

checks.title: Choose recurrence
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed schedule with scope, concurrency, cost, notifications, and duplicate handling. Test any configured route before enabling it. Setup completion does not publish or claim growth.
